source_contract: Finite driver shell q advances additively; Q4 spatial_response tangent differentiates spatial residual rows w.r.t same additive q, sameanchors/predecessor. Endpoint matrices used ONLY for Q4; native multiplicative rows not treated this way.
limitations: Simpson curvature is an estimate assuming a smooth fixed branch and sufficiently accurate endpoint tangents, not a rigorous truncation bound,complete-J proof or accepted alternative criterion. No new evaluation/refinement or tolerance change.
